title: PIC NEPA Data Standard v1.2
description: The Permitting Innovation Center (PIC) NEPA Data & Technology Standard v1.2 — a structured schema for environmental-review data collected during reviews conducted under the National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA), 42 U.S.C. §§ 4321 et seq. Defines 13 entity types (project, process_instance, document, comment, engagement, case_event, gis_data, gis_data_element, user_role, decision_element, process_model, process_decision_payload, legal_structure) and a uniform set of six provenance properties added in v1.2.

table:columns.name: leadAgency
table:columns.description: Federal agency that supervises preparation of the environmental documents for the project.

table:columns.name: startDate
table:columns.description: Environmental review initiation date (aggregated from process status).

table:columns.name: currentStatus
table:columns.description: Current phase of the NEPA / permitting / other authorization process (aggregated from process status). Enum-like: pre-application, underway, paused, completed.

table:columns.name: locationLat
table:columns.description: Center/centroid of project (shortcut for plotting on a map; should attach a GIS data object as well).

table:columns.name: dataSourceAgency
table:columns.description: Agency from which this data record was sent/retrieved/stored (may differ from record owner).

table:columns.name: dataSourceSystem
table:columns.description: System from which this data record was sent/retrieved/stored.

table:columns.name: lastUpdated
table:columns.description: Last update of the data record in the system.

table:columns.name: recordOwnerAgency
table:columns.description: Owner of the original data — the authoritative data source.

table:columns.name: retrievedTimestamp
table:columns.description: Timestamp of a retrieval or transmission (e.g. responding to an API call).
